file: A34\S34\new\S34_adopted.ens  (368 L records)

Classification of all 367 levels above the ground state:
  A  unique plain XREF letter whose dataset L-record matches E and DE byte-exact .... 331   source pinned by XREF, no note needed
  B  byte-exact source unique, but other plain XREF letters also fall inside DE ...  15   source pinned by byte-exact E+DE
  C  two datasets share adopted E and DE byte-exact ................................   1   level is fit-basis (default cL E$ applies)
  D  no byte-exact source, but documented by own cL E note / flag / fit basis .......  20
  E  needs revision ................................................................   0

=> 0 levels require revision. XREF notation alone determines the E(level) source: a dataset
   letter written WITHOUT a parenthesised energy means that dataset's level energy agrees
   with the adopted value; 'Letter(value)' deliberately records a different energy from that
   dataset. A level whose single plain letter also matches E and DE byte-exact has an
   unambiguous, readable source and needs no cL E$ comment.

Earlier '194 undocumented' conclusion RETRACTED: it ignored the plain-letter XREF rule and
counted the col-77 flag mechanism (which exists only for flags A, E, P) as the sole evidence.
